subject: POC kickoff + next steps — quick infra/permissions check
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Michaels <jordan@athenaai.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@athenaai.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff + next steps — quick infra/permissions check

Jordan — thanks again for the productive demo this morning. Quick recap and the concrete next steps so we have alignment before the engineering kickoff: 

- Goal: Validate inference latency and cost on your typical 8k prompt workload, integrate prefix caching for your session logs.
- Kickoff (1 hour): Thu Oct 15, 11:00–12:00 PT — scope: access, model pinning, sample traffic, metrics to capture. Invite already sent.
- Action items for Athena (priority order):
  1) Provide a service account with read/write to the test S3 bucket (name in runbook).
  2) Confirm whether you'll bring your own KMS key for token encryption (we support AWS KMS/HSM).
  3) Share a short sample prompt set (3–5 examples) so we can pre-config recommended quantization/batching settings.

Attached: Athena mutual action plan (MAP) with dates and responsibilities. Also here is the onboarding runbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-Athena-POC-Runbook.

If priorities changed and you want to postpone, say so and we can shift the kickoff or provide a 30-day trial extension and a hands-on 'infra bootcamp' with an engineer. Monica (cc) will support the session.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you running.

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: athena-mutual-action-plan-v1.pdf (PDF)]

From: Jordan Michaels <jordan@athenaai.com>

Cc: Priya Shah <priya@athenaai.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff + next steps — quick infra/permissions check

Thanks Vanessa — appreciate the clear recap. Two quick notes: 

1) We're still lining up a dev SME; hiring delays mean our main engineer won't be available until Oct 25. 
2) We need to clear some compliance questions before handing over S3/KMS access — Priya is on that and will follow up with a short checklist.

We definitely want to move forward, just heads up the initial setup will be delayed a bit. Can we keep the kickoff tentative and re-confirm next week?

—Jordan
Jordan Michaels
Head of ML Platform, Athena AI
jordan@athenaai.com | +1 (617) 555-0127

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff + next steps — quick infra/permissions check

Jordan — quick follow to check priority and offer help. I know hiring timelines slip; if your dev SME isn't available until 10/25, we can: 

- Move the kickoff to a lighter "kickstart" session focused on network & access (30 minutes) that your security/ops team can attend while engineering is ramping.
- Offer a 1:1 infra bootcamp with one of our Solutions Engineers (Ben) to do the heavy lifting (we can provision a temporary service account and walk through KMS/S3 settings).
- Extend the POC window by 30 days so you don't lose evaluation time while onboarding.

I'll attach our infra checklist to make it painless. If this sounds useful, say which days next week work and I'll coordinate.

If your leadership has reprioritized this work, that's fine — just let us know so we can reallocate internal resources.

Warmly,
Vanessa
--
[Attachment: redwood-infra-checklist.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Jordan Michaels <jordan@athenaai.com>

Cc: Priya Shah <priya@athenaai.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff + next steps — quick infra/permissions check

Vanessa / Ben — thanks, that approach would work. 

- We can do the 30-minute network/access session on Tue Oct 26 at 10:00 PT. Priya will join for the compliance bits.
- Please re-send the runbook and the infra checklist (I couldn't open the XLSX behind our firewall).
- A couple of compliance questions up front: how long do logs persist by default in hosted? Do you support customer-managed KMS keys in our account?

I'll confirm the calendar once Ben confirms availability.

—Jordan

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Michaels <jordan@athenaai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff + next steps — quick infra/permissions check

Great — we’ll lock Tuesday Oct 26, 10:00 PT for the 30-minute access session and I’ll have Ben lead the run-through. Monica will own the trial extension so you won’t lose any evaluation days. 

Answers to Jordan’s quick compliance questions: 
- Logs: default retention in hosted is 30 days; we can configure retention to any policy for Dedicated/Private and we can set retention to 90/180/365 days on request.
- KMS: yes — we support customer-managed keys (AWS KMS and on-prem HSM). We can provide a short integration doc for the KMS grant flow.

Resources attached and linked:
- onboarding runbook (Drive link): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-Athena-POC-Runbook
- infra checklist (inline PDF copy attached)
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/ATH-2026-045

If you run into firewall issues with attachments, we can place the files in the Drive folder and share directly with Priya’s org account. See you Oct 26 — calendar invite to follow.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
